profile.headline: I help companies build AI products that meet HIPAA, SOC 2 and FDA standards.
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in healthtech, AI/ML systems, and cybersecurity. Experienced with HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance, FDA 510(k) submissions, and designing and deploying production applications and AI/ML pipelines across Google Cloud and AWS.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
● Turned static matplotlib model-validation images into interactive analytics (visx zoom, brush and tooltips) for Bland-Altman, scatter and error-distribution charts. Added metric cards (MAE, RMSE, R², normality) and one-click PDF reports for clinical and regulatory teams.
● Built the backend of an OCR pipeline that reads burned-in text on ultrasound frames. It recovers estimated delivery dates the product was missing and redacts patient identifiers before images are stored. 
● Shipped end-to-end MFA (setup wizard, challenge flow, recovery codes, institution-level enforcement) and a searchable audit-log viewer with CSV export for global admins. 
● Localized the frontend (i18next) and FastAPI backend (Babel) in English, Spanish and Portuguese. 
● Migrated E2E testing from Cypress to Playwright (200+ tests) runs against the production build in CI.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Shipped RescueBot, an in-app scheduling assistant on a fine-tuned GPT-4o-mini model that collects service details conversationally, quotes from live pricing, and hands off to a human on request.
● Built AI-generated price quotes: an LLM classifies the vehicle and normalizes the requested time from free text, then business rules price the job.
● Architected AmeniLink, a multi-tenant property-management SaaS for web, iOS and Android (React 19, TypeScript, MUI, Firebase, Capacitor) with invitations, RBAC and service requests.
● Built the dispatcher portal (Nuxt/Vuetify), technician mobile app (React Native/Expo) and Node/Express API, including real-time auto-dispatch for ~14,000 calls and ~15,000 SMS a month, push/SMS notifications, Stripe payments and lead intake webhooks.
● Rebuilt the marketing site on Astro + Sanity + Cloudflare (~$6,700/yr saved, 99+ PageSpeed). Consolidated 913 legacy pages into ~21 canonical pages and added Sanity AI agent actions for content.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · React Native · Twilio · Geospatial Data · Vue.js · Nuxt.js · Node.js · Sequelize · Software Design · Systems Design

positions.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
positions.description:
● Led penetration testing efforts of web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure in healthcare systems, identifying critical vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, misconfigurations).
● Penetration-tested healthcare web apps and APIs and delivered remediation guidance for HIPAA-regulated environments.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: ● Designed the architecture for the DORITOS® Crash the Super Bowl submission platform on GCP, with Gemini and Cloud Vision automatically reviewing user-generated entries. The design was approved by PepsiCos CISO (Chief Information Security Officer).
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform · AI/ML · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Systems Design · Software Design

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Built a React annotation app (AWS Amplify) where physicians labeled anonymized fetal and maternal heart-rate data to validate the algorithm behind an FDA 510(k) submission. 
● Refactored legacy Python signal-analysis code for a Bluetooth fetal/maternal monitor into testable units, establishing a comprehensive pytest suite (0% to 99% coverage) required for FDA 510(k) submission compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · pandas · Node.js · Python (Programming Language) · MATLAB · Full-Stack Development · NumPy · Cloud Computing · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native · pytest · Systems Design · AWS Amplify · Next.js

● Owned store releases on Apple's App Store Connect and Google Play Console

projects.title: wakethenile.com
projects.description:
Custom E-Commerce Site built with Sanity backend and Astro frontend. Site was originally built in WordPress using a custom theme and plugin that I developed but back in June I did a 1:1 migration and rebuilt the exact same design using Sanity for backend to replace WordPress dashboard and Astro/CloudFlare Pages replaced the dedicated VM on google cloud. 

Read the case study here: https://coffey.codes/case-study/wordpress-to-serverless-headless-commerce
